comments.body:
I'm curious if it is possible to use one of the ActivityStreams Activity Types, from which the basic - Create, Update, Delete - types come, versus an Object Type.

How about for a newly added InboundReference, the type were "Add": https://www.w3.org/TR/activitystreams-vocabulary/#dfn-add

And for a deleted InboundReference, the type were "Remove": https://www.w3.org/TR/activitystreams-vocabulary/#dfn-remove

 

Examples:

 

Add:

{
  "@context": "https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams",
  "id": "urn:uuid:3c834a8f-5638-4412-aa4b-35ea80416a18",
  "type": "Add",
  "name": "New Inbound Reference",
  "actor": "http://lakesuperior.artic.edu/fcrepo/rest/prod/agents/fedoraAdmin",
  "object": {
    "id": "http://lakesuperior.artic.edu/fcrepo/rest/prod/works/01",
    "type": [
      "aic:Work",
      "ldp:Container",
      "ldp:RDFSource"
    ]
  }
  "target": {
    "id": "http://lakesuperior.artic.edu/fcrepo/rest/prod/statuses/active",
    "type": [
      "aic:ListItem",
      "ldp:Container",
      "ldp:RDFSource"
    ]
  }
}

 

Remove:

{
  "@context": "https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams",
  "id": "urn:uuid:3c834a8f-5638-4412-aa4b-35ea80416a18",
  "type": "Remove",
  "name": "Delete Inbound Reference",
  "actor": "http://lakesuperior.artic.edu/fcrepo/rest/prod/agents/fedoraAdmin",
  "object": {
    "id": "http://lakesuperior.artic.edu/fcrepo/rest/prod/works/01",
    "type": [
      "aic:Work",
      "ldp:Container",
      "ldp:RDFSource"
    ]
  }
  "target": {
    "id": "http://lakesuperior.artic.edu/fcrepo/rest/prod/statuses/active",
    "type": [
      "aic:ListItem",
      "ldp:Container",
      "ldp:RDFSource"
    ]
  }
}
Based on the results of my investigation ( FCREPO-2803 Closed ), I don't think this is possible. Best case scenario is to suppress the inbound reference events.
Just to confirm I was wrong above and the PR is for re-mapping inbound reference events to https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#Follow

Updated with code review changes.

I also modified the WrappedJcrEvent javadoc to explicitly state we are wrapping an org.modeshape.jcr.api.observation.Event and NOT a javax.jcr.observation.Event

Lastly I added a test to check for not rewrite an event to an Inbound reference, this should be caught by all the other tests but just in case.
